speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa nwa m nwanyị, ị ma etu mbe si nweta akpụkpọ ya gbawara agbawa?
englishText: My granddaughter, do you know how the tortoise got his cracked shell?
statement: Dad asks his granddaughter if she knows why tortoises have cracked shells.
falseStatement: Dad asks his granddaughter if she knows how the tortoise got a smooth shell.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter says she does not know and asks him to tell her.
falseStatement: The granddaughter says she already knows and doesn't want him to tell her.

speaker: dad
igboText: Otu ụbọchị, e nwere nnukwu oriri n'eluigwe.
englishText: One day, there was a great feast in the sky.
statement: Dad says there was a big feast in the sky one day.
falseStatement: Dad says there was a small feast in the forest one day.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter asks if the tortoise went.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks if the birds went.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ee. Ọ riri nri karịa mmadụ niile.
englishText: Yes. He ate more food than everyone else.
statement: Dad says the tortoise ate more food than everyone else.
falseStatement: Dad says the tortoise ate less food than everyone else.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter asks what happened next.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks what happened before.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says the birds became angry.
falseStatement: Dad says the birds became happy.

speaker: granddaughter
statement: The granddaughter asks what the birds did.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks where the birds went.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ha weghachiri ábụ́bà ha ha gbazinyere ya.
englishText: They took back the feathers they had lent him.
statement: Dad says the birds took back the feathers they had lent the tortoise.
falseStatement: Dad says the birds gave more feathers to him.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Kedu ka o si lọta n'ụlọ?
statement: The granddaughter asks how the tortoise got home.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks where the birds went home.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says the tortoise fell from the sky.
falseStatement: Dad says the tortoise flew safely home.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mgbe o dara, akpụkpọ ya gbawara agbawa. Ọ bụ ya mere mbe ji nwee akpụkpọ gbawara agbawa ruo taa.
englishText: When he fell, his shell cracked. That's why tortoises have cracked shells today.
statement: Dad explains that the shell cracked when the tortoise fell, and that is why tortoises still have cracked shells.
falseStatement: Dad explains that the shell stayed whole when the tortoise fell, and that is why tortoises have smooth shells.
